name: Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering lets restaurants publish a digital menu and accept orders from their WordPress site.

Free Features

Menu & Ordering
* Responsive menu with photos, descriptions, modifiers, and pricing
* Featured items carousel, full-text search, sticky category nav
* Cooking preferences — Uber Eats-style chips (spice, salt, oil, sugar, and more) fully configurable from the admin
* Special instructions — free-text box on every item so customers can type any request
* Pay-at-restaurant ordering (pickup, delivery, dine-in)
* Scheduled orders, tip options, tax, service fee, delivery fee
* Coupon / promo code support

Personal Center (logged-in customers)
* Order history with item images, status badges, and “Order again”
* Email notifications on every status change (Preparing → Ready → Done)
* Favorites with item image and direct add-to-cart
* Saved address book (up to 5 addresses, auto-fills delivery field)
* Editable profile (name, phone) and spend statistics
* Native WordPress accounts — no extra tables

Operations
* Kitchen Display ([yatoon_kitchen]), Order Status page ([yatoon_order_status])
* Real-time new-order browser alerts + sound (admin Orders page and kitchen display)
* Admin order management with one-click status updates
* Full Cooking Preferences admin page — add, edit, delete groups and options freely

Pro Features

  • Stripe card payments, Apple Pay, Google Pay
  • Alipay and WeChat Pay
  • Twilio SMS status notifications (in addition to email)
  • Google, Facebook, Instagram social login

Shortcodes

  • [yatoon_menu] — full menu with cart and checkout
  • [yatoon_kitchen] — real-time kitchen display
  • [yatoon_order_status] — customer order tracking

External Services

Free version: no external services. Pro adds Stripe, Twilio, Google/Facebook/Instagram OAuth (all opt-in).
Freemius SDK bundled for licensing — no data sent unless you connect an account.
* Freemius: https://freemius.com/ · Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin → upload ZIP → Activate
  2. Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Settings — configure your restaurant
  3. Add [yatoon_menu] to any page
sections.changelog:
3.7.0

  • Added Cooking Preferences admin page — freely add, edit, and delete preference groups and options without touching code.
  • Added Special Instructions free-text box on every item modal (Uber Eats style). Toggle in Settings.
  • Upgraded Personal Center: order history now shows item images, fulfillment type, and notes; “Order again” on every order.
  • Added spend stats to Personal Center header (total spent, order count, saved items).
  • Added Favorites panel with item images and direct “add to cart” button.
  • Added editable Profile — customers can update their name and phone number.
  • Added Address Book — save up to 5 delivery addresses; tap any saved address to auto-fill the delivery field at checkout.
  • Added email notifications for every status change (Preparing, Ready, Done), not just “Ready”. Includes order-tracking link.
  • Pro: Twilio SMS also fires on Preparing and Done status changes.
  • Added Order Status Page URL setting — included as a tracking link in all customer status emails.
  • Added Special Instructions and Customer Accounts toggles to Settings.

3.6.0

  • Added cooking preference chips (Uber Eats style) and real-time new-order sound alerts.

3.2.6

  • WordPress.org Plugin Check compatibility fixes.
